rulings.a: Is the mosque itself affected? Raised by all three round-2 readers. Eyad does not know; source wording (port complex, some parts may be closed) stays. Not a translation defect; recorded as a known open question. The zh value keeps the port complex as subject and adds nothing beyond the source.
rulings.b: zh-specific: 修缮 in the card echoed the programme name 历史清真寺修缮计划 in body_zh, so the reader took the mosque as being restored again. Translation-level issue; minimal judge edit made: 港口建筑群内正在开展修缮工作 -> 港口建筑群正在整修. 整修 (refurbishment/restoration of a site, standard on heritage-site notices) keeps the restoration sense, avoids both 修缮 (programme) and 修复 (body: the mosque 完成修复), and puts the complex itself as subject as in the source. 施工 rejected: reads as construction, loses restoration. 修复 rejected: echoes 完成修复 directly.
rulings.c: No final 。 (site convention); internal full-width ， only; no ASCII punctuation; U+0020 only in the YAML.

notes: Accuracy 29: 整修 for restoration work is a near-equivalent (slightly broader); may be closed -> 可能暂不开放 faithful.

Out of scope: ru/de rows on the same line still Посещение/Besuch (own pipelines); round-2 zh out-of-scope list (summary/body repetition, 纳季德 vs 内志, 首座, 这一机构 etc.) for a later polish batch.
